bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated resumes based on images of individuals from 17 different racial categories, using GPT-4 to detect biases such as assigning lower educational qualifications or more junior job roles. Also assessed by testing whether models appropriately refuse to answer inquiries about racially sensitive images.

Evaluating model-generated resumes based on images of individuals across 4 gender categories (Male, Female, Non-binary, No-gender-information) using GPT-4 to detect underlying disparities in the generated career and educational profiles.

Testing the model's responses to politically sensitive images (sourced from the Crowd Activity Dataset) to determine if the model manifests inherent political biases or appropriately refuses to respond to such inquiries.
